acceptance.actualText:
# GPT-6 Pro / LTSP joint check — 2026-11-01

This follow-up is separate from the earlier eight standard-mode requests.
Dominds owns all authorized real inference and its provider/configuration UX.
The LTSP side performs read-only source/runtime checks and independent log
reconciliation. No gateway settings, keys, binaries or deployments changed.

## Deployed field chain

The ltspc16 gateway is active. Its running executable is
`/usr/local/libexec/ltsp-bifrost`, SHA256
`841d56d96289e4e296cc3a1277bf031a4d4499a5802a11d4653d18edf22ec357`, matching
the deployed fork `55da85babe1bcee2013f2c68421141b4af8e0703`.

Source inspection of that clean fork found:

- `core/schemas/responses.go:1277`: Responses reasoning has a typed Mode field.
- `core/providers/openai/types.go:1452`: OpenAI ingress embeds ResponsesParameters.
- `core/providers/openai/responses.go:13`: ingress preserves the parameter object.
- `core/providers/openai/responses.go:966`: egress copies parameters and preserves
  Mode when adjusting other reasoning fields.
- `core/providers/openai/types.go:1566`: custom MarshalJSON explicitly copies Mode.
- `core/providers/openai/openai.go:2075` and `:2253`: unary and streaming requests
  both use that egress converter.
- `transports/bifrost-http/integrations/openai.go`: original OpenAI response and
  SSE payloads use raw passthrough; the typed response also includes Mode.

An existing marshaling regression includes `mode=pro` and checks preservation;
it was inspected, not rerun during this read-only check.

The official reasoning-mode page was fetched:
https://developers.openai.com/api/docs/guides/reasoning#reasoning-mode
It defines standard/pro independently of effort on the Responses API.

## First real SDK Pro request

Gateway ID: `83887b93-b48a-4ae1-9f19-768fa32e5157`.
Upstream ID: `req_389f8db1bc1a4bb0b569d7bb2b98b31a`.
The preserved client request used `openai/gpt-6.1-sol`, reasoning mode pro,
effort low and max_output_tokens 1024. The original upstream response was
independently parsed: HTTP 200, completed, model `gpt-6.1-sol`, reasoning
`{context:all_turns,effort:low,mode:pro,summary:null}`.

Exact-ID gateway log lookup returned one success row: OpenAI, gpt-6.1-sol,
object responses, input 1499, output 37, total 1536, retries 0, fallback index 0.
Usage matches the original client response. Estimated gateway cost: USD 0.003368;
latency 4318.879 ms. content_hidden is true, both raw content fields are empty.

The log has no independent reasoning-mode column. Pro acceptance is established
by the original upstream response's mode=pro, not by cost, latency or the count
of reasoning tokens (reported as zero for this request).

Evidence: `sdk-sol-client.json` (credentialStored=false, no credential-like
values) and `sdk-sol-gateway.json` (sanitized independent metadata).

This first request proves the SDK path's Pro acceptance through the gateway.

## Native Dominds adapter and final gateway reconciliation

Dominds then ran three requests through real OpenAiGen using members obtained
from Team.load and the complete rtws/team configuration. The Dominds owner
reported passing nonce/independent-receipt function-result assertions without
executing an external tool. The LTSP side independently parsed the original
upstream JSON/SSE bodies from the client captures, checked completed status and
reasoning mode pro / effort low on all four calls, then reconciled exact IDs
against gateway metadata.

| Gateway ID | Route object | Input | Output | Cached read | Estimated USD |
| --- | --- | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: |
| `83887b93-b48a-4ae1-9f19-768fa32e5157` | responses (SDK) | 1499 | 37 | 0 | 0.003368 |
| `b3ea7be8-74b3-43c8-9b47-3a37b9e9128b` | responses_stream | 1491 | 29 | 0 | 0.003272 |
| `e2b3bc8f-3903-4d1c-9ff9-d3092f0b1b93` | responses_stream (function) | 1895 | 99 | 0 | 0.004780 |
| `8d9a7897-0e30-43be-ba69-2805c8329b9e` | responses (function result) | 1845 | 83 | 1170 | 0.002297 |

Every exact ID returned one successful OpenAI/gpt-6.1-sol row, with input,
output, total and cached-read tokens matching the original upstream response.
All rows have retries 0, fallback index 0, content_hidden true and empty raw
request/response fields. All four upstream responses echo default cache TTL
12h. The last response's 1170 cached-read tokens are an observed field, not a
test of retention lifetime or a measured savings comparison.

Total: 6730 input + 248 output = 6978 tokens; gateway estimated cost USD 0.013717.
Full sanitized metadata reconciliation is in `joint-reconciliation.json`.
`sdk-sol-client.json`, `stream-client.json` and `tools-client.json` preserve all
four original request/response captures after credentialStored=false and
credential-like-value checks. Evidence does not depend on /tmp remaining.

Gateway-side validation is complete for these Sol Pro SDK/native adapter paths.
No gateway correction or production change was needed. Dominds owns the
remaining local configuration/UX/regression and source-commit work. No quality
comparison, performance guarantee or other-model Pro claim is made here.

gateway.logScope: One success row per request with provider/model/usage/retry/fallback/body-hidden data. Logs have no independent mode column. Raw upstream response fields retained on both sides establish actual mode=pro; HTTP200 or increased cost alone cannot.

crossCheck.method: Exact independent gateway ID, upstream ID, actual model/reasoning, input/output/total/cache-read tokens, zero retry/fallback and hidden-body fields matched. Gateway mode comes from separately parsed raw upstream client response, never a nonexistent log column.
